User: I met my colleague Mark at the cooking class last night, and we had a great time learning new recipes together.
Assistant: Nice — glad you had fun! Would you like to send Mark a follow-up email? I can draft or send one for you. Below are a few short templates — tell me which you want (or edit any) and whether to send now or save as a draft. Also let me know if you want to attach photos or recipes, or if I should look up Mark’s email in your inbox.

1) Quick thank-you
Hi Mark —  
Great meeting you at t

he cooking class last night! I had a blast learning those recipes with you. Thanks for the tips — would you be up for swapping notes or trying one of the dishes together again soon?  
Cheers,  
[Your name]

2) Share recipes / photos
Hi Mark —  
I enjoyed the class last night! I’m attaching the recipe/photos I took — hope they help. Want to try cooking one together this weekend?  
Best,  
[Your name]

3) Suggest another meetup
Hey Mark —  
Really enjoyed the cooking class last night. If you’re free, want to

get together next Saturday to cook one of the recipes we learned? Could be fun to practice together.  
Thanks,  
[Your name]

4) Connect professionally (LinkedIn mention)
Hi Mark —  
It was great meeting you at the cooking class last night. I enjoyed our conversation about [topic]. Would you like to connect on LinkedIn? Here’s my profile: [link].  
All the best,  
[Your name]

What would you like me to do next?
- Send one of the above now (which template and any edits? attach files? send or save as draft)
-

Search your inbox for Mark’s email (tell me his last name or some details, e.g., “Mark from marketing, cooking class”)
- Or I can draft multiple options for you to choose from.

User: Please remember that I started a new hobby of painting and spent the weekend creating a beautiful landscape piece.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you’ve started painting and spent the weekend creating a beautiful landscape piece.

Would you like me to save any extra details with that memory? For example:
- Medium (oil, acrylic, watercolor), title, or colors used
- A photo of the painting
- A reminder to paint again (when?)
- Or to mention this in future emails (e.g., when writing to Mark or co

lleagues)

Tell me which (if any) and I’ll add it.

User: Please remember that I spent time with my friend Emily last night discussing our upcoming trip to Italy.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you spent time with your friend Emily last night discussing your upcoming trip to Italy.

Would you like me to save any extra details with that memory? For example:
- Travel dates or length of the trip
- Cities or places you plan to visit (Rome, Florence, etc.)
- Any reservations or bookings already made
- Emily’s last name or contact info (so I can find her e

mails)
- Packing/preferences or things you both decided (museums, food, budget)
- A reminder to book tickets or check passports/visas (and when)

Also — do you want me to:
- Set a reminder for a specific planning task or date?
- Search your inbox for emails from Emily or about the trip?
- Draft a follow-up message to Emily summarizing your plans?

Tell me which details to save or what action you want and I’ll add it.

User: I enjoyed catching up with my old college friend, Rachel, over brunch at a cozy cafe downtown this morning.
Assistant: Nice — sounds like a lovely brunch. Would you like me to save that as a memory?

If so, I can store extra details (pick any):
- Rachel’s last name or contact info (so I can find her emails)
- Topics you discussed or any decisions made (trip plans, meetups, etc.)
- A photo from brunch
- A reminder to follow up or plan the next get-together (date/time)

Also — do you want to send Rachel

a follow-up message now or save a draft? Here are three quick templates you can pick or edit:

1) Quick thank-you
Hi Rachel —  
It was so nice catching up over brunch this morning at the cafe downtown. I really enjoyed our conversation — let’s not leave it so long next time!  
Cheers,  
[Your name]

2) Suggest another meetup
Hey Rachel —  
Loved catching up today. Want to meet again next weekend (coffee or a walk)? Would be great to keep the conversation going.  
Thanks,  
[Your name]

3) Share photos / pl

an
Hi Rachel —  
Great seeing you this morning! I took a couple of photos from brunch — want me to send them over? Also, if you’re free, let’s plan that [activity you discussed].  
Best,  
[Your name]

Tell me:
- Save this as a memory? (yes/no + any extra details)
- Send one of the templates now, save as draft, or just draft a custom message?
- Should I search your inbox for Rachel’s email (provide her last name or any detail if possible)?

User: Please remember that I tried a new restaurant with my friends last Friday, and we had a blast exploring the menu together.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you tried a new restaurant with your friends last Friday and had a blast exploring the menu together.

Would you like me to save any extra details with that memory? (Pick any)
- Restaurant name and location
- Type of cuisine / standout dishes you tried
- Friends’ names who came
- A photo or receipt
- Your rating or whether you’d recommend it

- Any plans to go back (date/time) or a reminder to make a reservation
- Whether to mention this in future emails (e.g., when writing to those friends or colleagues)

Also — want me to:
- Save this memory now with the extra details you provide?
- Draft a quick message to the friends (thank-you or share photos)?
- Search your inbox for the reservation or any related emails?

Tell me which details to save and what action (if any) you want.

User: I caught up with my cousin Sarah yesterday over a virtual coffee date, and we shared updates on our families.
Assistant: Nice — glad you had a good catch-up with Sarah. Would you like me to save this as a memory?

If yes, I can store extra details (pick any):
- Sarah’s last name or contact info (so I can find her emails)
- Which family updates you discussed (kids, parents, moves, health, etc.)
- Any decisions or plans you made (next call date/time)
- A photo or screenshot from the call
- A reminder to

follow up (when?)

Want help drafting a quick follow-up message? Here are three short templates — tell me which to send now, save as a draft, or edit first:

1) Quick thank-you
Hi Sarah —  
Really enjoyed our virtual coffee yesterday and catching up on the family. Let’s do it again soon!  
Love,  
[Your name]

2) Share a recap / next steps
Hey Sarah —  
Great talking yesterday. Just to recap: [brief bullet of plans/updates]. Are you free to do another call in a couple of weeks?  
Hugs,  
[Your name]

3) Sh

are photos / family notes
Hi Sarah —  
Loved hearing the family updates yesterday — I’m attaching the photo you asked about. Want to set up another chat next month?  
Best,  
[Your name]

What would you like me to do next?
- Save this as a memory (yes/no + any extra details to include)
- Send one of the templates now (which one and any edits?), or save as draft
- Search your inbox for Sarah’s email (tell me her last name or any detail like “Sarah from Boston”)
- Set a reminder to follow up (when?)

User: I had a great time trying out a new recipe with my friend Jessica at the cooking class last night.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you tried a new recipe with your friend Jessica at the cooking class last night.

Do you want me to save this as a memory now? If so, any extra details to include (pick any):
- Jessica’s last name or contact info (so I can find her emails)
- Recipe name or dishes you tried
- A photo of the dish or recipe file
- Whether you want to plan/ schedule another cook-togethe

r (when?)
- Anything you decided (tips, favorite part, rating)

Also, do you want any immediate actions?
- Draft or send a follow-up to Jessica (I can draft templates: quick thank-you; suggest cooking the recipe together; share photos/recipe)
- Search your inbox for Jessica’s email (give last name or another detail if possible)
- Set a reminder to follow up or to cook again (date/time)

Tell me which details to save and which action you want.

Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you went on a weekend trip to the mountains with your friend Alex and had a great time hiking and exploring the scenic trails.

Would you like me to save any extra details with that memory? For example:
- Trip dates or length of the trip

- Accommodat

ion details (where you stayed)
- Any highlights or notes (wildlife seen, favorite viewpoint)
- Alex’s last name or contact info (so I can find emails)
- A reminder to share photos or plan a return trip (when?)

Also — do you want me to:

- Draft a quick thank-you or follow-up message to Alex (send or save as draft)?
- Search your inbox for emails from Alex (tell me his last name or another identifying detail)?
- Set a reminder related to the trip (when a

nd what)?

Tell me which details to save or what action you’d like.

User: What did I discuss with my friend Emily last night?
Assistant: You and Emily talked about your upcoming trip to Italy. 

Would you like me to save more trip details (dates, cities, reservations), set reminders (passports, bookings), search your inbox for emails from Emily, or draft a follow-up message summarizing what you planned?

Assistant: You caught up with Rachel — your old college friend — over brunch at a cozy cafe downtown this morning.

Would you like me to save this as a memory, draft or send a follow-up to Rachel, or search your inbox for her email?

User: What did I do with my friends last Friday?
Assistant: You tried a new restaurant with your friends last Friday and had a blast exploring the menu together.

Would you like me to save more details about that (restaurant name/location, cuisine or standout dishes, friends’ names, a photo/receipt, your rating), draft a message to the friends, or search your inbox for any related emails or reservations?

User: What did I do when I caught up with my cousin Sarah yesterday?
Assistant: You caught up with your cousin Sarah over a virtual coffee yesterday and you shared updates about your families.

What would you like me to do next?
- Save this as a memory (I already have a note, but I can add more details)
- Draft or send a follow-up to Sarah (suggested message below)
- Search your inbox for Sarah’s email (tell me her last name or any detail if you want)
- Set a reminder to follow up or schedule another chat

Suggested quick follow-up:
Hi Sarah —  
Loved hearing the family updates yesterday — I’m attaching the photo you asked about. Want to set up another chat next month?  
Best,  
[Your name]

Tell me which action to take (and any edits to the message).

Assistant: You went on a weekend trip to the mountains with your friend Alex — you had a great time hiking and exploring the scenic trails.

Would you like me to do any of the following?
- Save more details to memory (trip dates, trail names, highlights, photos, where you stayed, Alex’s last name/contact)

rom Alex (tell me his last name or any other detail if you want)
